'''Loswilla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] snowy-white fluffy [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]. She was aboard the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] when a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] went undercover. She frequented [[Xerrol's Place]] and tried to hit on one of the Rebels, as she was interested in a temporary romantic entanglement with them.
